skills.name: Innocent Look
skills.description: Himawari gazes upon enemies innocently. Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *Makes enemy skills unusable (6 sec) *Applies charm effect to 1 enemies within range. (6 sec)

skills.name: Cotton Candy
skills.description: Shiro performs a trick. Good effects to allies.   *Skill Evade Rate +60% (7 sec) *Skill Resistance +60% (7 sec) *HP x 80% Area Recovery (per sec) (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Crayon Shinchan
abilities.description: Crayon Shinchan Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Enemy Cost Increase2
abilities.description: Gives a set chance of greatly increasing the Mineral Cost for one of the opposing team's Rangers when Rangers with this Ability are deployed.  This Ability can activate from 10 seconds after the battle starts.
